scope: Text patterns for exact post-pass families in public point-addition sources. A match reports a setting; it does not prove exactness.

families.name: conditional-AND pass
families.source: src/point_add/cond_pass.rs, header comment (author jackylee0424, as credited in public note 59359890)

documented_levers.m: a CCX whose AND equals one control's value becomes a CX
documented_levers.u: a CCX that XORs a wire's whole AND back out becomes an X-basis measurement and a conditional CZ
documented_levers.f: a CCX whose result only phases read becomes Clifford phases on the operands
documented_levers.s: a CCX read only under one classical bit is built under that bit
documented_levers.r: a reset or measured end absorbs the writes before it as phases under the outcome
